notes.title: Full release
notes.notes:
The base game is now out of early access with version 1.0

All levels, boss fights and endgame highscore levels. 3 different poses for lewd scenes, as well as lots of unlockable equipment: Tentacle wraps, Gag ball (with muffled sound effects), Tentacle suction drainers 

I plan on adding more content in the future as free updates. Secret areas with new levels, 3 new characters and more unlockable equipment (such as rope, harness and options for dicks instead of tentacles)
